sources.title: Qwen AgentWorld 35B A3B | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B is a 35B Mixture-of-Experts language world model with 3B active parameters, built on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base. It natively simulates seven agent interaction domains: MCP tool calling, search, terminal, software engineering, Android, web, and game environments. Trained end-to-end via CPT to SFT to RL. Supports 262,144-token context and uses thinking mode by default.

sources.title: Qwen AgentWorld 35B A3B — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Qwen AgentWorld 35B A3B is an open-weight multimodal model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion active parameters per token, designed for agent-based applications with extended context. The model uses a hybrid sparse mixture-of-experts architecture with Gated DeltaNet linear attention and supports text, image, and video inputs.
